definitions.explanation: A substance used for cleaning, especially for washing clothes or dishes.

examples.japanese: {洗剤|せんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦すぎないで→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't use too much detergent.

notes:
{洗剤|せんざい} is the general term for cleaning agents.

TYPES OF DETERGENT:
- ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (laundry detergent)
- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：09842_you⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (dish soap)
- ⟦{住居|じゅうきょ}→住居：11612_juukyo⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：09842_you⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (household cleaner)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗剤|せんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to add detergent)
- ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (powder detergent)
- ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (liquid detergent)
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{洗剤|せんざい} (synthetic detergent)
